svg.title: An external relation map records the three-fraction transformation
svg.desc: A sparse map records three fourths becoming nine twelfths and two thirds becoming eight twelfths before joining five twelfths. It is labeled as a record of relations, not an attempted picture of a non-sensory inner experience.
svg.text: RECORD OF THE RELATIONS · NOT AN INNER-SCENE CLAIM

g.text: Same common-unit mathematics; reported format may differ or be absent.
